questions.question: What is the name of Mickey Mouse's girlfriend?
questions.fact: Minnie and Mickey both appeared in "Steamboat Willie" in 1928. Their voice actors married each other in real life.

questions.question: What kind of animal is Pluto?
questions.fact: Pluto first appeared in 1930. The dog was named around the time the planet Pluto was discovered.

questions.question: What is Buzz Lightyear's catchphrase?
questions.fact: Buzz Lightyear was named after Buzz Aldrin, the second person to walk on the Moon.

questions.question: What does "Hakuna Matata" mean?
questions.fact: "Hakuna matata" is a real Swahili phrase, used in East Africa long before "The Lion King".

questions.question: Which princess has a pet tiger named Rajah?
questions.fact: Jasmine was the first Disney princess who wasn't European.

questions.question: What is the name of the fairy in "Peter Pan"?
questions.fact: Tinker Bell was created by J.M. Barrie and later became a mascot for Disney itself.

questions.question: What is the name of Aladdin's monkey?
questions.fact: Abu was voiced by Frank Welker, who has done hundreds of animal and creature voices, including Scooby-Doo.

questions.question: Which Disney film has the song "A Whole New World"?
questions.fact: "A Whole New World" won the Oscar for Best Original Song in 1993.

questions.question: What is the name of the Little Mermaid?
questions.fact: "The Little Mermaid" is based on a fairy tale by Hans Christian Andersen, which has a much sadder ending.

questions.question: Who is Elsa's sister in "Frozen"?
questions.fact: Frozen was very loosely inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale "The Snow Queen".

questions.question: In "Up", what lifts the house into the sky?
questions.fact: Pixar's artists drew over 20,000 balloons for the flying house. Lifting a real house would take millions.

questions.question: What is the name of the robot WALL-E falls in love with?
questions.fact: EVE stands for "Extra-terrestrial Vegetation Evaluator".

questions.question: In "Monsters, Inc.", what do the monsters call the little girl?
questions.fact: Boo's voice actor was a toddler. The crew followed her around with a microphone to record her playing.

questions.question: Which Pixar film takes place inside a girl's head, with her emotions?
questions.fact: Inside Out's emotions are Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust. The sequel added Anxiety and others.

questions.question: "Coco" is inspired by the Day of the Dead in which country?
questions.fact: Mexico's Día de Muertos honours loved ones who have died, with altars, marigolds and sugar skulls.

questions.question: What is the name of the boy in "Coco"?
questions.fact: Miguel dreams of being a musician like his hero, Ernesto de la Cruz.

questions.question: Which Disney film is set in Colombia and features a magical family?
questions.fact: Encanto was inspired by Colombia's music, nature and its writer Gabriel García Márquez's "magical realism".

questions.question: In "Encanto", "We Don't Talk About…" whom?
questions.fact: "We Don't Talk About Bruno" reached No. 1 in the US charts, the first Disney animated song to do that since "A Whole New World" in 1993.

questions.question: Which Disney princess loses a glass slipper?
questions.fact: In the Brothers Grimm version of Cinderella, her slippers are made of gold, not glass.

questions.question: How many dwarfs are there in "Snow White"?
questions.fact: The seven dwarfs are Doc, Grumpy, Happy, Sleepy, Bashful, Sneezy and Dopey.

questions.question: Which of Snow White's dwarfs wears glasses and leads the group?
questions.fact: Snow White (1937) was Disney's first full-length animated film. People called it "Disney's Folly" before it became a hit.

questions.question: Who is the sea witch in "The Little Mermaid"?
questions.fact: Ursula's look was reportedly inspired by the drag performer Divine.

questions.question: Which villain wants a coat made of puppies?
questions.fact: "101 Dalmatians" is based on a 1956 book by Dodie Smith, who owned nine Dalmatians.

questions.question: Who is Simba's evil uncle?
questions.fact: "Scar" isn't his real name. Spin-off books say it was Taka.

questions.question: What is the name of the meerkat in "The Lion King"?
questions.fact: Real meerkats live in groups, and some stand guard on their back legs while the others look for food.

questions.question: What kind of animal is Pumbaa?
questions.fact: Pumbaa is often called the first Disney character to fart on screen.

questions.question: What is the name of Kristoff's reindeer in "Frozen"?
questions.fact: Real reindeer have noses that warm up the cold air before it reaches their lungs.

questions.question: What kind of animal is Bambi?
questions.fact: Bambi was originally a roe deer in the Austrian book. Disney made him an American white-tailed deer.

questions.question: What is the name of Bambi's rabbit friend?
questions.fact: Thumper is named after the way he thumps his foot, just like real rabbits do to warn of danger.

questions.question: What is the name of Bart Simpson's baby sister?
questions.fact: The Simpsons first appeared in 1987 as short clips. It's the longest-running American animated series.

questions.question: Which Stone Age family lives in Bedrock?
questions.fact: The Flintstones was the first animated series to air in prime time in the US, in 1960.

questions.question: What colour are the Smurfs?
questions.fact: There are over 100 Smurfs. In French they're called "Schtroumpfs" and in Spanish "Pitufos".

questions.question: The Smurfs were created in which country?
questions.fact: The Smurfs were created by Belgian artist Peyo in 1958.

questions.question: Who is SpongeBob's best friend?
questions.fact: Patrick is a starfish, and his voice actor, Bill Fagerbakke, also played in the TV comedy "Coach".

questions.question: Where does SpongeBob live?
options: In a pineapple under the sea
questions.fact: SpongeBob's creator, Stephen Hillenburg, was a marine biology teacher before becoming an animator.

questions.question: What is the famous cat and mouse duo called?
questions.fact: Tom and Jerry won seven Oscars for best animated short film.

questions.question: What does Bugs Bunny famously say?
questions.fact: Bugs Bunny first said "What's up, Doc?" in 1940, munching a carrot like a character in a film.

questions.question: "Yabba Dabba Doo!" is the catchphrase of…
questions.fact: "Yabba Dabba Doo" was reportedly improvised by voice actor Alan Reed when a script just said "Yahoo!"

questions.question: What does Popeye eat to get strong?
questions.fact: Popeye is often said to have boosted spinach sales in the US by about a third in the 1930s.

questions.question: What breed of dog is Scooby-Doo?
questions.fact: Scooby-Doo's full name is Scoobert Doo.

questions.question: Which Japanese studio made "Spirited Away"?
questions.fact: Spirited Away won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature in 2003, the only non-English film to do so for many years.

questions.question: Who directed "My Neighbor Totoro"?
questions.fact: Totoro is Studio Ghibli's logo, and Miyazaki draws much of his films by hand.

questions.question: What is Pikachu?
questions.fact: Pikachu's name comes from Japanese sounds: "pika" for an electric sparkle and "chu" for a mouse squeak.

questions.question: Which Pixar film is about a superhero family called the Parrs?
questions.fact: The Incredibles' costume designer, Edna Mode, was voiced by the film's director, Brad Bird.

questions.question: What is the name of the inflatable robot in "Big Hero 6"?
questions.fact: Baymax's soft, huggable design was inspired by real research into soft robots.

questions.question: In "Zootopia", what animal is Judy Hopps?
questions.fact: Judy Hopps is the first rabbit police officer in Zootopia. In Spain the film is called "Zootrópolis".

questions.question: In "Zootopia", what animal is Nick Wilde?
questions.fact: Real red foxes can hear mice moving under the snow, then leap up and pounce on them.

questions.question: What is the name of the dinosaur toy in "Toy Story"?
questions.fact: Rex is a Tyrannosaurus. Toy Story (1995) was the first fully computer-animated feature film.

questions.question: In "Cars", what is the name of the red race car?
questions.fact: His number, 95, is a nod to 1995, the year Pixar's first film, Toy Story, came out.

questions.question: Which Disney film is about a girl who joins the army in ancient China?
questions.fact: Mulan is based on an old Chinese poem, the "Ballad of Mulan", about a woman who fought in her father's place.

questions.question: What is the name of Mulan's little dragon?
questions.fact: Mushu was voiced by Eddie Murphy in the original English version.

questions.question: Which Disney princess has a chameleon named Pascal?
questions.fact: Rapunzel's hair in "Tangled" is about 21 metres long, according to the filmmakers.

questions.question: Which servant in "Beauty and the Beast" is a candlestick?
questions.fact: Lumière is French for "light", fitting for a candlestick.

questions.question: What is the name of the demigod in "Moana"?
questions.fact: Maui is a real figure from Polynesian legends, said to have pulled islands out of the sea with his fishhook.

questions.question: In "Finding Nemo", what kind of fish is Dory?
questions.fact: Real blue tangs are also called surgeonfish because of sharp spines near their tails.

questions.question: In "Ice Age", what is the squirrel Scrat always chasing?
questions.fact: Scrat is a made-up "saber-toothed squirrel", though scientists did later find a squirrel-like fossil with long teeth.

questions.question: In "Despicable Me", what are the little yellow helpers called?
questions.fact: The Minions speak "Minionese", a made-up mix of Spanish, Italian, French and other words. And lots of "banana"!

questions.question: In "Kung Fu Panda", what is the panda's name?
questions.fact: Kung Fu Panda's Furious Five match real kung fu animal styles: tiger, crane, mantis, viper and monkey.

questions.question: What is the name of the princess in Pixar's "Brave"?
questions.fact: Merida was Pixar's first female lead character, and Brave won the Oscar in 2013.

questions.question: What happens when Pinocchio lies?
questions.fact: Pinocchio was written by Italian author Carlo Collodi in the 1880s.

questions.question: What is the name of Pinocchio's cricket friend?
questions.fact: Jiminy Cricket sings "When You Wish Upon a Star", which became Disney's theme song.

questions.question: What is the name of the talking dog in "Up"?
questions.fact: Dug's collar translates his thoughts into words, which gives the famous line "Squirrel!"

questions.question: In "The Simpsons", what is the name of Homer's boss?
questions.fact: Mr. Burns's first name is Charles, and he's said to be over 100 years old.
